**Initial launch – fun AI-powered texting and flirting coach.**

- Rate your texts with honest, multi-dimensional feedback (“Rate My Rizz”).
- Instantly upgrade weak messages with 3-tier rewriter (“Glow Up My Text”).
- Generate vibe-tagged reply options, each with a risk level (“Reply Generator”).
- Practice with different AI personas and get real-time feedback (“Conversation Simulator”).
- Share results easily with clean, screenshot-ready ASCII cards.
